disclaimer: Simulated. No hardware exists. The arm, the board and the wearer are all models; only the control stack, the wire protocol and the kinematics are the real implementations.

simulated_time.note: What the arm does. A property of the design, not of this machine.

host_cost.note: Measured on the machine that ran this, not on the arm's controller. See docs/CONTROL_LOOP_TIMING.md.

actuation.saturation_note: A position servo reaches its torque limit while accelerating and that is normal. What would not be normal is reaching it while holding, which shows up as a move that never settles.
